source.post_text:
There was a point last season when Mikel Arteta benched Eberechi Eze, and the reaction was loud. 

After spending around £67 million on him, many fans questioned why such an expensive signing was being left out. Eze was an unused substitute in four consecutive Premier League matches, while some fans accused Arteta of frustrating his development and deliberately holding him back. 

The pundits joined in too, some claimed Arteta didn't fancy him, didn't like him, or was simply refusing to use him properly.

replies.text: Trust the process after last season's title run, rotation will happen with this depth and Eze can still impact games off the bench without needing to force him over Odegaard or Tzolis every single week.
